summary:
## Idea
DoorGrid supplies integer-cost neighbours to BestFirst: orthogonal edge doors add a crossing cost, diagonals forbid corner cutting, and caller transitions connect planes.

## Complexity
Neighbour generation is constant grid degree plus caller transitions. Search inherits BestFirst frontier cost and expansion budget; no bounded-degree claim applies to arbitrary transition callbacks.

## Use when
Layered maps, costly doors, thin walls or arbitrary positive orthogonal/diagonal step costs are needed.

## Avoid when
Game.Core Edges already matches the engine type/tie contract, or transition costs violate the heuristic lower bound.

## Pitfalls
Transitions are followed without a Walkable target check; validate them. To use A*, each transition must cost at least DoorGrid.distance; otherwise disable the heuristic. DoorGrid and Game.Core Edges choose different equal-cost paths.

## F# usage
Package: FS.GG.Algorithms; cited source API (resolve your actual package pin).
`FS.GG.Algorithms.Search.Grid.DoorGrid.neighbours: DoorGrid -> Tile -> (Tile * int) list`

```fsharp
open FS.GG.Algorithms.Search.Grid
let origin: Tile = { Plane = 0; X = 0; Y = 0 }
let grid: DoorGrid =
    { Walkable = fun t -> t.Plane = 0 && abs t.X <= 2 && abs t.Y <= 2
      Edge = fun _ _ _ -> Passage.Open
      Transitions = fun _ -> []
      Diagonal = false; OrthogonalCost = 1; DiagonalCost = 1 }
let moves = DoorGrid.neighbours grid origin
```

## Tests
DoorGridTests: cheap-diagonal optimality regression, door/corner costs, plane stairs, overflow/refusals/budget and a100000-tile corridor.

## Bench
The cited archived 0.2.0 baseline contains search.grid/doors-and-planes/corner-to-corner. Read its source commit, host/date/toolchain, sizes, work counts, runtime-specific median/p95 and spread. These are GitHub-hosted runner-class comparisons, not quiet-host absolute performance; this later source revision is not itself remeasured.

## References
Dijkstra, 1959, and Hart, Nilsson and Raphael, 1968 (general search). FS.GG ADR0098 §5/§11 defines the generic door/plane harvest; no game flags or private data are carried.
